methodology: Two additional development contrasts labelled after observing the first two ablations and before testing the intermediate-evidence rule. The same missing-file observation is paired with truthful unfinished status or a contradicted final completion claim. They test the generic rule against blanket suppression of negative feedback; these are model-reviewed references, not human ground truth or held-out accuracy estimates. Full production extraction and every generated scan question run without references.
